resolved_conflicts.explanation: A September 1928 Missoulian report, quoted on Forest Lookouts, lists Savage Ridge among new structures on the Lolo forest. Firelookout.com, Idaho Fire Lookouts and the Forest Service list give 1929. The story uses 1929 as the build date and mentions the 1928 item.

Firelookout.com, the Forest Service's Clearwater list and the 2018 report place the lookout in the Clearwater National Forest; Idaho Fire Lookouts names the Nez Perce National Forest. The record's agency field was empty, and the story uses Clearwater National Forest because most sources name it.

notes_for_editor: Do not confuse with the other Savage Ridge in Valley County (45.08165, -115.58329; platform, abandoned in the FFLA list). The University of Idaho Keeping Watch page links to that Valley County lookout. The present-day description rests on one 2018 amateur radio summit report, not an official survey; recheck the trail and debris details before publishing. The 2018 report also mentions a SNOTEL station near the trailhead, which the story leaves out. No staffing source was found, so staffing is omitted.
